_about: The mission's cargo manifest on the slate (scripts/pda_screen.gd Cargo app; docs/master-design.md §2, systems-and-items §15). Twelve pallets and the three walking carriers that went down ahead of you. Paperwork, not a quest list: each line is greyed out until you find it, and says nothing about where it is. 'source' tells the slate how to check it: storm_drop (pallet 1), drop_field:<kind> (pallets 2-4 and 6; since 14 Nov tools are 3 and GAR-Y 4), wreck:<vehicle> (21 Nov, R3: the buggy's shell, the drone's capsule, the HabRover's heavy lander; seen_text when found wrecked, glimpsed_text for the HabRover's glint); the rest come with later steps.

pallets.name: Pallet 1 · Life support
pallets.holds: The core's air cartridge, ten ration packs and the sample kit (hand corer, scoop and bags).

pallets.name: Pallet 2 · Field power
pallets.holds: A rolled solar blanket and a battery pack.

pallets.name: Pallet 3 · Field tools
pallets.holds: A rock hammer, a bright lamp, and a suit patch kit.

pallets.name: Pallet 4 · GAR-Y
pallets.holds: GAR-Y, the commissioning rover, folded for the trip.

pallets.name: Pallet 5 · Scout buggy
pallets.holds: A two-seat open buggy, in its own cargo shell. The shell split when it hit; the buggy needs fixing before it drives.
pallets.seen_text: Found in its split shell. Damaged: one for later, once there are parts.

pallets.name: Pallet 6 · Print Shop
pallets.holds: The base's printer and its regolith intake.

pallets.name: Pallet 7 · Comms
pallets.holds: The high-gain antenna's spares and the base's long-range radio.

pallets.name: Pallet 8 · Instruments
pallets.holds: The scout drone, in a small capsule of its own, with the field instruments.
pallets.seen_text: Its capsule found, sprung open. The drone needs fixing.

pallets.name: Pallet 9 · HabRover
pallets.holds: The pressurised rover, whole, on its own heavy lander. It came down on rockets, not a chute.
pallets.seen_text: Its heavy lander found, tipped on a crumpled leg. The rover rolled off and needs fixing.
pallets.glimpsed_text: A glint on the horizon when the sun is low. Something big came down out there.

pallets.name: Pallet 10 · HabRover stores
pallets.holds: The HabRover's cabin stores: food, water and its spare life support.

pallets.name: Pallet 11 · Compact reactor
pallets.holds: The base's long-term power: a small fission reactor and its radiators.

pallets.name: Pallet 12 · Spares
pallets.holds: Spare parts for every system on the manifest.

walkers.name: Walker 1 · the core
walkers.holds: The base's core: airlock, life support, power hub and a bunk, carried whole.

walkers.name: Walker 2 · Regolith printer
walkers.holds: The big printer that builds room shells from the ground itself.

walkers.name: Walker 3 · Power kit
walkers.holds: The base's solar arrays and batteries.
